.Notes
[[sep-components-note-1]]^[1]^ A 32-bit read with address bit 2 set returns 0xCA11AB1E. +
[[sep-components-note-2]]^[2]^ A write to a reserved address in 0x1080_2000-0x1080_20FF or 0x10A1_0000-0x10A4_FFFF answers SLVERR. +
[[sep-components-note-3]]^[3]^ An access to an unmapped offset also latches PIC source 41. +
[[sep-components-note-4]]^[4]^ With no TRNG fitted, the reference integration answers DECERR, 0xBADCAB1E / SLVERR. +
[[sep-components-note-5]]^[5]^ A 32-bit read of the upper word of a register also answers SLVERR, 0x0.
